Package hadur117.core.melee

Class Momentum

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.melee.Momentum
final class Momentum extends Object
TMODE-49, momentum: where a team member really is, tick by tick, while it drives to a spot from its present heading and velocity under the engine's movement rules.

The wave check (TMODE-11, TMODE-27) and the teammates'-bullet check (TMODE-25) drive each candidate from a standstill, already pointed at it. A spot behind the member then looks as quick to reach as one ahead, though the member must first brake at 2 px a tick and turn. This drive takes the brake and the turn into account, so a turn back is priced as it is flown. Our own code on the engine's published rules (Robocode's Rules and RobotPeer): each tick the body turns at most 10 - 0.75 |v| degrees toward the spot (backwards when that is the shorter turn), then the velocity moves toward the speed that still stops on the spot, by 1 px a tick up and 2 down.

      static double[][] drive(double x, double y, double heading, double velocity, double toX, double toY, int ticks, boolean fullSpeed, double width, double height)
      The member's centre after each of ticks ticks driving to (toX, toY) from (x, y) at heading (radians, the engine's: 0 north, clockwise) and velocity; out[t - 1] is {x, y} after tick t. With fullSpeed the drive keeps 8 px a tick through a sharp turn, else it caps at TURN_SPEED there, as the drive does. A wall stops the member on the field's edge.
